metadata.title: That 1 kill where Valorant said ‘Hold my crosshair’ and did the hard work
metadata.description:
Didn’t aim, didn’t care, and somehow got the kill.
Enemy probably uninstalling to rethink life.
Click if your aim’s on vacation but you still clutch a frag!
Watch me pretend this was all skill for a sec.

Tap if your aim’s broke but the game still loves you!

#valorant #gamingfails #luckshot #funnygaming #shorts
